verdict.rationale: Navan's API and MCP surface support querying and updating many records (e.g., 'retrieve and update...across the expense surface' and natural-language queries like 'show every flagged expense over $500...grouped by department'), suggesting bulk read/filter capability, but there is no explicit documentation of true bulk write/update actions (e.g., batch-approve, batch-edit) across many items in one call. Missing for 10: explicit bulk write/update endpoint documentation, evidence of transaction limits or batch size support, and independent confirmation of bulk operation success.
